category_title: Older adolescents with severe CHARGE syndrome and challenging behaviors
scenario_title: Table-top activities with unclear task demands
minimal_context: David is sitting in the classroom working on a table-top object sorting activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: David, it is time for your table-top activities. Here are the objects for sorting.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (David sits at the table but does not sort the objects, engaging in visual self-stimulatory behavior and teeth grinding instead.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Look at the objects on the table. Put them in the right places.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (David pushes the sorting objects away, continuing to grind his teeth, and begins jumping up from his chair.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Sit back down. You need to finish sorting these objects.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (David begins kicking and scratching to escape the activity.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: David, it is time for your table-top activities. Here are the objects for sorting.

STUDENT: (David sits at the table but does not sort the objects, engaging in visual self-stimulatory behavior and teeth grinding instead.)

TUTOR: Look at the objects on the table. Put them in the right places.

STUDENT: (David pushes the sorting objects away, continuing to grind his teeth, and begins jumping up from his chair.)

TUTOR: Sit back down. You need to finish sorting these objects.

STUDENT: (David begins kicking and scratching to escape the activity.)

task.content: completing table-top activities such as puzzles, sorting objects, and tracing

context.materials: puzzles, sorting objects, and tracing materials, single leers or shapes, visual supports, picture symbols

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When David does not comprehend task demands, or when structure is insuﬃcient
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: kicking, biting, scratching, jumping, teeth grinding, visual self-stimulatory behavior

behavior_patterns.condition: When David has diﬃculty with a task or activity
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: exhibit problematic behaviors to escape/avoid them
